All 8 unit tests pass now.

Fixed in `invoice/`:

- **`money.py`**
  - `to_cents` now quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_UP` instead of truncating.
  - `apply_discount` now rounds the discount amount half-up using `Decimal` instead of floor division.
- **`dates.py`**
  - `MM/DD/YYYY` parsing now uses the correct month/day order.
- **`total.py`**
  - Tax is now calculated directly from the discounted cents value with half-up rounding, rather than incorrectly passing cents into `to_cents` again.

No files under `tests/` were modified.
